meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据,产出质控报告与信号图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组测序研究,需要把比对数据转成可视化结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into QC charts and genome-wide signal maps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study genomes and need to visualize sequencing data for QC.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 deepTools 命令行工具处理测序比对数据:把 BAM 转成归一化的 bigWig 覆盖度轨道、跑相关性/PCA/指纹等质控,并生成 TSS 或峰区的热图与轮廓图。
howto.when: 当你提到把 BAM 转成 bigWig、检查 ChIP 质量、画 TSS 热图等,或要分析 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq 等测序数据时,由它接管。

say.text: 把我的 ChIP-seq BAM 转成 RPGC 归一化的 bigWig。
say.note: 会调用 bamCoverage 生成 .bw 文件。

say.text: 对比 ChIP 和 input,画指纹图和相关性热图。
在 TSS 附近做热图,按 kmeans 3 分组。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs deepTools CLI tools on sequencing data: converts BAM to normalized bigWig tracks, runs QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and draws heatmaps/profiles around TSS or peaks for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to convert BAM to bigWig, check ChIP-seq quality, or plot a TSS heatmap, or when analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq or ATAC-seq data.

say_en.text: Convert my ChIP-seq BAM to an RPGC-normalized bigWig.
say_en.note: Runs bamCoverage to produce a .bw file.

say_en.text: Compare ChIP vs input with a fingerprint and correlation heatmap.
Make a heatmap around TSS with kmeans 3.
